matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: An alpha-balanced cross-entropy alone is not sufficient to overcome extreme foreground-background imbalance in dense detection, motivating the modulating term that focal loss adds.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Focal Loss with gamma=2 yields a 2.9 AP improvement over the alpha-balanced cross entropy loss.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Focal Loss reshapes the standard cross-entropy by down-weighting the contribution of well-classified examples, allowing effective training under extreme foreground-background class imbalance.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The proposed Focal Loss reshapes the standard cross entropy loss to down-weight the loss assigned to well-classified examples.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Hard negative mining and online hard example mining are insufficient to address the dense one-stage class imbalance that Focal Loss handles by reweighting.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Focal Loss outperforms the best variants of online hard example mining by over 3 points AP.
